definitions.gloss: to get hungry; to be hungry
definitions.explanation: To feel hunger. The blunt, everyday counterpart of お{腹|なか}が{空|す}く, heard mostly from men and in rough casual speech; the past form {腹|はら}が{減|へ}った is the usual way to say "I'm starving."

examples.japanese: ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹|はら}が{減|へ}る。
examples.english: I get hungry after club practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧てない⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{腹|はら}が{減|へ}って⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I haven't eaten anything since morning, so I'm starving to death.

notes:
Built on ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ "belly" and ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ "to decrease." It sounds masculine and rough; in polite or mixed company say ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}きました.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腹|はら}が{減|へ}った: I'm hungry
- {腹|はら}が{減|へ}って⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦|いくさ}→戦：28574_ikusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できぬ→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: you can't fight on an empty stomach (proverb)
- ⟦{腹|はら}ぺこ→腹ぺこ：15601_harapeko⟧: starving (informal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{腹|なか}が{空|す}く→お腹が空く：33935_onakagasuku⟧: to get hungry — the neutral form anyone can use
